title: Prototype
description: Pointer to one interface prototype made in Design on the Design canvas. A prototype is a pointer to a canvas plus the part of the interface it explores; the canvas holds the prototype itself. Each pointer names the intent it was made for, so the brief-writer and the team can find every prototype made for that intent with `legion document list --doc-type prototype --json`.

intent.description: Id of the intent document the prototype was made for

canvas.description: Link to the prototype's Design canvas

explores.description: The part of the interface the prototype explores
